prerequisites.label: Skill 07 — KIE Setup
prerequisites.satisfy: Complete Skill 07 (kie-setup) before installing Skill 67: it establishes the KIE account/credential context this skill builds on.

prerequisites.label: KIE API Key
prerequisites.satisfy: KIE_API_KEY is the KIE.ai API bearer credential (Authorization: Bearer <KIE_API_KEY>). The env var NAME is repo convention — KIE's own docs show only the literal placeholder YOUR_API_KEY; no fetched page documents an env var name (see 01-kie-common.md, status UNDETERMINED). Confirm it is SET (never print the value; check ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env, openclaw.json env.vars, and ~/clawd/secrets/.env). If absent, ask the operator to add KIE_API_KEY to ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (chmod 600), then: openclaw config set env.vars.KIE_API_KEY "$KIE_API_KEY". Do NOT mint a new key.
